rubric.text: Applies a quantum Fourier transform to the register that will hold the sum, moving it into a phase (Fourier) encoding.

Adds the other operand with controlled phase rotations R_l = diag(1, e^{2 pi i / 2^l}) controlled by the operand's qubits, with l set by the combined bit significances; rotations that would be trivial are omitted.
Applies the inverse QFT to return the sum to the computational basis.
Uses no ancillary qubits and leaves the operand register unchanged.
Overflow wraps naturally, giving addition modulo 2^m (an extra qubit would give non-modular addition).

provenance: Rubric written from papers/arxiv-1411.5949.txt Sec. 3-4 before any scored run.
